applicability: Next multi-agent fix-and-verify round; two same-shape occurrences argue for severity-tiered proof language in the sde-fullstack and verification-engineer charters (description edits owe the overlapping routing cluster before/after)

evidence.environment: sde-fullstack fix pass and verification-engineer charter behavior under a Fable-session coordinator
evidence.source_reference: SAFE-002 round cost review, 2026-08-04 session: fix pass consumed 226k tokens vs 154k for the original build; the pre-existing Windows test_ledger_drift failure was independently re-attributed three times (builder, coordinator, verification-engineer) despite being passed as a known fact; full residue/isolation ceremony fired for P3 comment and message edits

expected_behavior: Proof effort scales with severity and stakes: P2/authority fixes keep revert-and-refail rigor; P3 prose or message edits get targeted tests only; an already-attributed environment fact travels as a citation and is not re-proven by each consumer
observation: Proof effort does not scale with severity: revert-and-refail proof, full-suite reruns, worktree re-attribution of already-attributed environment facts, and full packet ceremony are applied uniformly to P2 fixes and to P3 comment tweaks alike, making small fix passes cost more than the feature they follow
reason: Proportionality rule covers the evidence-reuse clause only; it never states severity, P2, P3 or stakes, and revert-and-refail at verification-engineer.md:42-44 remains categorical with no scaling language. Disproportionate first-time proof on a P3 is not repeated work and is not forbidden. Issue 83 carries the repair proposal; sde-fullstack.md:142-146 is the phrasing precedent.
